home.heading: Hi! I'm Inês, and I care for your pet as if it were my own.
home.body1: "Os Pets da Inês" was born on 17 November 2024 with a very clear purpose: to offer dedicated, personalised care, given with love, to pets.
home.body2: I personally look after every animal myself, making sure they're safe and well, and I always send owners updates so they never have to worry.
home.heroAlt: Inês smiling, crouched down, walking four dogs on leashes along an outdoor path

services.heading: Three ways to care for your pet

quotes.quote: Excellent service! Inês is very affectionate and attentive with our cats and took great care of them. This is the second time she's looked after our boys and we recommend her 100%. She sends photos and videos every day, and a status update on how they are and how they behaved.
quotes.author: Márcia Sousa

quotes.quote: A very positive experience, super attentive with the animals! Our dog is reactive around some dogs and people and ADORES Inês! We always feel at ease leaving our dog with her, and we love the videos and photos she sends. 10/10, an excellent professional and a great person!
quotes.author: Diogo Maçarico

quotes.quote: For two weeks, Inês was home in the truest sense of the word. Being home means cuddles, affection, walks, treats and lots of play! We always knew they were in good hands, and Inês kept in constant contact with us. We recommend her and trust her with our eyes closed!
quotes.author: Marta Paixão

about.heading: Inês Paulo
about.body1: Hi! My name is Inês, I'm 27 years old, and I've been passionate about animals for as long as I can remember.
about.body2: I grew up surrounded by dogs and cats, and that closeness became an essential part of my life. Over the years I've cared for animals of every age, size and personality — friends' and family's pets as well as clients' — and every experience deepened my love for them.
about.body3: I believe every animal is unique and deserves full attention and care, especially when their owners aren't around.
about.body4: I'm attentive, patient and trustworthy, and I make a point of adapting to each animal's specific needs. I also have experience with dogs and cats of many breeds and personalities, which lets me understand and respect what makes each of them different.
about.photoAlt: Inês smiling next to a dog wearing a harness, with apartment buildings in the background

hub.heading: Our services
hub.intro: Every service starts with a free, no-commitment initial assessment, so we get to know your pets and tailor the service to your needs.

petBoarding.title: Pet Boarding
petBoarding.cardText: Your pet stays in a family environment, with personalised attention, plenty of play and affection.
petBoarding.detail1: Travelling for work or taking a few days off, and worried about your pet's wellbeing? Let me help make sure your furry friend gets all the care they deserve while you're away!
petBoarding.detail2: With Pet Boarding, your pet enjoys a family environment, personalised attention, plenty of play and affection at the pet-sitter's home.
petBoarding.photoAlt: Dogs resting together on a bed during pet boarding

petSitting.title: Pet Sitting
petSitting.cardText: I visit your pet at home: feeding, fresh water, playtime and company, without breaking their routine.
petSitting.detail1: I visit your pet at your own home, taking care of feeding, fresh water, playtime and company, keeping their usual routine stress-free.
petSitting.detail2: You get photos, videos and a status update after every visit.
petSitting.detail3: I also do cat sitting, always charged at the 1-dog rate regardless of how many cats are involved.
petSitting.photoAlt: Cats at home during a pet sitting visit

dogWalking.title: Dog Walking
dogWalking.cardText: Walks adapted to your dog's needs and fitted around your schedule. Happy, healthy dogs.
dogWalking.detail1: Out of the house all day, unwell, or just don't have time to walk your dog? Let me help give your furry companion the walks they deserve!
dogWalking.detail2: Walks are adapted to your dog's needs and fitted around your schedule, so your dog gets all the attention they need.

booking.heading: Booking Conditions
booking.intro: How it works, from first contact to coming home.

steps.title: How does the initial assessment work?
steps.body: We schedule a no-commitment meeting to get to know your pet, their routines, and work out which service makes the most sense.

steps.title: How do bookings and the deposit work?
steps.body: Bookings are only confirmed once a 50% Booking Deposit is paid.

steps.title: What is the Trial Day and when does it apply?
steps.body: Every new dog must complete a mandatory Trial Day. If severe anxiety or a need for continuous supervision is identified, an individualised-care fee of +5€ per day applies. If reactivity towards other animals is identified, or full exclusivity is required (no integration or stay with other guests), the booking may still be accepted — but due to the separation logistics required, it will be charged at the 2-dog occupancy rate.

steps.title: What are the operating hours and after-hours fees?
steps.body: Official hours are 08:00 to 20:00. An After-Hours fee of 5€ applies per hour or part thereof. From 22:00, doors close for the night and the pet stays over (an extra full day is billed for the following day).

steps.title: What do I receive during my pet's stay?
steps.body: You receive photos, videos and a status update every day, so you never have to worry.

high.label: High season
lines: More than 30 days' notice: full deposit refund.
Between 15 and 30 days: 50% of the deposit is retained.
Less than 15 days: 100% of the deposit is retained.

low.label: Low season
lines: More than 15 days' notice: full deposit refund.
Between 7 and 15 days: 50% of the deposit is retained.
Between 3 and 7 days: 100% of the deposit is retained.

contact.hoursNote: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 – 20:00. Outside these hours a 5€ per hour (or part thereof) fee applies.
